id: \bI have been studying the Pokémon in these caves for many years. But no matter how hard I try I can't seem to catch one.
en: \bI have been studying the Pokémon in these caves for many years. But no matter how hard I try I can't seem to catch one.
it: \bStudio i Pokémon di queste grotte da molti anni. Ma per quanto mi impegni, non riesco proprio a catturarne uno.

id: \bOh you have one! Will you give it to me to study?
en: \bOh you have one! Will you give it to me to study?
it: \bOh, ne hai uno! Me lo daresti per studiarlo?

id: \bThank you very much! Take this as thanks.
en: \bThank you very much! Take this as thanks.

id: \bIf you bring me one I'll give you something as a thanks.
en: \bIf you bring me one I'll give you something as a thanks.
it: \bSe me ne porti uno, ti darò qualcosa come ringraziamento.
